data.name: Casterbane Shot
data.description: Life in the Mana Wastes, where magic has unpredictable and often fatal effects, has taught you to disable spellcasters with your firearms. If you ready a ranged attack with a firearm to attack a spellcaster when he begins casting a spell and successfully hit your opponent, you can expend 1 grit point to increase the target's concentration check DC for being injured while casting by 5.
prerequisites: PRETEXT:Prerequisites: Amateur Gunslingeruc or the grit class feature, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, base attack bonus +4.
